introduction-text:
Immersive Lighting

There are many kinds of lights in the world, torches, candles, lanterns.
Immersive Lighting attempts to add a few more which are a little more immersive.
The first is the Liquid Fuel Lamp which can be fueled with Aqua Vitae or any other combustible liquid.

fuels-text:
Lamp Fuels

The Liquid Fuel Lamp burns any combustible liquid. Each fuel has its own flame colour, brightness, smoke and burn time. Thin, volatile spirits burn quickest; thicker oils and fats are drawn up the wick more slowly. Soot makes a flame glow, so clean spirit flames are dim and oils are bright, but smoke that escapes costs some of the light, and turning the wick up makes a lamp smoke more.

Burn time per litre at the lowest wick (default settings; each wick step burns one more portion at a time)
 • Aqua vitae and spirits: about 50 min. Pale blue to near white, dim, almost no smoke.
 • Linseed (flax) oil and seed and nut oils: about 1 h 50 min. Yellow-orange to orange, bright, some smoke.
 • Olive, avocado and engkala oil: about 2 h 5 min. Golden yellow, the brightest, little smoke.
 • Ghee and lard: about 2 h 30 min. Warm yellow to dull orange-red, smoky.

Lighting a lamp
Hold a firestarter or a lit torch against the lamp. Dousing it and changing the wick need no tool. Look at a lamp to see its fuel, flame and how long the fuel will last.

Servers
Server owners can change the burn rate, brightness and smoke, and whether an ignition source is required, in ModConfig/immersivelighting-server.json.
